en.title: Xolo Maridueña Returns as Blue Beetle in James Gunn's 'Superman' Sequel
en.summary: The star of the 2023 film 'Blue Beetle' is set to reprise his role as Jaime Reyes in the upcoming DC film 'Man of Tomorrow.' Maridueña expressed initial uncertainty about the character's future until a pivotal call from DC Studios co-head James Gunn.
en.body:
For fans of **Blue Beetle**, the future of Jaime Reyes in the DC Universe felt uncertain after his solo film debuted in 2023. Actor **Xolo Maridueña** recently shared that he, too, was unsure if the character would return.

"I was in Japan with my friends; nobody knew anything," Maridueña recalled, speaking about the period after the release of **Blue Beetle**. This uncertainty was a stark contrast to the vibrant energy of his first outing as the alien-armored hero. Directed by Angel Manuel Soto, the film introduced **Jaime Reyes**, a recent college graduate who stumbles upon an ancient alien scarab that bonds with him, granting him incredible superpowers. The film was praised for its heart and its focus on family and culture, but its box office performance left many wondering about the character's trajectory within the evolving DC landscape.

## A Call from the Top

The tide turned, however, when **James Gunn**, co-head of DC Studios, reached out. Gunn, who is directing the upcoming **Superman** film, **'Man of Tomorrow'**, personally contacted Maridueña to discuss his return. This call brought clarity and excitement, confirming that Blue Beetle would indeed be part of the new DCU. The news has been met with considerable enthusiasm from fans who were captivated by Maridueña's portrayal and eager to see more of the character.

> "The Most Humbled" — Xolo Maridueña

Maridueña expressed profound gratitude for the opportunity, describing the moment he learned of his return as "the most humbled" he has ever felt. This signifies a significant endorsement from the new leadership at DC Studios, suggesting that **Blue Beetle** is a character they believe in and want to integrate into their grander plans for the DCU. His inclusion in **'Man of Tomorrow'** marks the first time he will don the suit since his 2023 debut, a significant step for the character's continued presence on screen.

## What's Next for the Scarab

While specific details about **Blue Beetle's** role in **'Man of Tomorrow'** have not yet been announced, his confirmed presence in the **Superman** sequel is a major development. Fans will be eagerly anticipating more information about how Jaime Reyes and his scarab will interact with **Superman** and potentially other heroes within this new DC continuity. The film is currently in production, with **James Gunn** at the helm, promising a fresh start for the DC Universe.

This confirmation is a beacon of hope for fans who championed the first film, suggesting that **Blue Beetle** is not just a one-off but a lasting fixture in the future of DC storytelling. The collaboration between Maridueña and Gunn on **'Man of Tomorrow'** is poised to be a pivotal moment for the character, bridging his established presence with the new era of DC films.
